decisions.reason: The GIS solution-building platform is close to the firm's core geospatial integration knowledge and was given its own page in 2019, and the firm's own R&D lets it keep learning from and improving it.

Mobile field data capture sits close to the firm's established GIS offer and was steadily presented on its own page, so the firm can interpret results and refine it, although its similar mobile component C was dropped.
The search extension builds directly on the firm's web-map platform expertise and was actively versioned in 2019, which shows the ongoing development that strong related knowledge supports.
